writeup: TIC 229473505 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 11.1970 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing a dimming of 0.03%, with a signal-to-noise ratio of 11.3 from the Box Least Squares search algorithm. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal at the target location, though the centroid offset of 17.9 arcsec warrants consideration. No secondary eclipse was detected. The object does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel candidate. The machine-learning screening score of 0.79 suggests the pipeline's model favors this as a real target, and the candidate passed all data quality checks without flagging concerns.
